hero.titleHighlight: Every answer cited to the page.
hero.subtitle: Precise answers, cited to the line. Upload a PDF, DOCX, spreadsheet, or code file, and ask it anything — every claim traces back to its source.

features.heading: Built to answer with evidence.
features.subtitle: Excerpta is not a generic chatbot pointed at a file. Every part of it exists to keep an answer traceable to the exact place it came from.

items.title: Multi-format upload
items.description: PDF, DOCX, CSV, and code files upload as-is. No conversion step, no lost formatting.

items.title: Source citations
items.description: Every answer names the exact page it came from — not a paraphrase you have to take on faith.

items.title: Auto-scroll to source
items.description: Click a citation and the document jumps straight to the passage, highlighted in place.

pricing.heading: Simple, transparent pricing.
pricing.subtitle: Start free, upgrade when you need more room.

whatsNew.heading: What's new.
whatsNew.subtitle: Excerpta is actively evolving. Here's what shipped most recently.

items.title: Polished landing experience
items.description: A dedicated public landing page, SEO metadata, and a real preview image.

items.title: Account & appearance settings
items.description: Manage your profile, switch themes, and delete your account and data.

items.title: Public sharing
items.description: Turn any conversation into a read-only link anyone can open, no sign-in needed.

items.title: Export conversations
items.description: Download any conversation as a formatted PDF or DOCX, citations included.

howItWorks.heading: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: Three steps, from a raw file to an answer you can verify.

steps.title: Upload your document
steps.description: Drop in a PDF, Word file, spreadsheet, or code file. Excerpta parses it and prepares it for search in seconds.

steps.title: Ask a question
steps.description: Ask in plain language. Excerpta searches the full document for the passages that actually answer it.

steps.title: Get a cited answer
steps.description: Read the answer, then click any citation to jump straight to the source page — highlighted, in context.
